recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-15137 unless the work group separately wants all conceptual diagram labels normalized to exact resource-name casing.
issue_request: FHIR-15137 was a Published/Persuasive, auto-approved OO correction for STU3 requesting that the Diagnostics Module diagram change the old Procedure Request/ProcedureRequest label to ServiceRequest.
initial_application: The direct application appears to be git commit bfe0f386b8ca990099c6f5748a19fc98fbde1b73, "GF#15137, GF#14956", which modified images/diagnostic-module-resources.png. The broader resource rename had already been reflected in source/diagnostics-module.html by 06bd9f6ffe08096694a3424721006e5fdcd82d3a, which replaced ProcedureRequest text and links with ServiceRequest.
additional_context: The current build includes diagnostics-module.html and diagnostic-module-resources.png through publish.ini, and ServiceRequest is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. The current diagnostics module page names ServiceRequest in the index, narrative, and resource table, and the current diagram/PPTX source no longer contains Procedure Request or ProcedureRequest. The remaining rendered diagram label is "Service Request", matching the removal of the obsolete ProcedureRequest label; normalizing diagram display text to exact CamelCase would be optional editorial cleanup beyond the applied typo correction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source and included diagram no longer contain the obsolete Procedure Request/ProcedureRequest wording that FHIR-15137 asked to remove.
